notes.title: Level Editor Update is Here! | SokobotS Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]SokobotS level Editor is now available![/b]

Create, test, and share your own SokobotS puzzles!

What's new:
[list]
[*] A full-featured Level Editor accessible from the main menu
[*] Place robots, switches, boxes, and traps to design your own challenges
[*] Test mode to instantly try out your creations
[*] Save your levels locally and share them to steam workshop!
[/list]

Also:
[list]
[*]UI improvements and minor bug fixes
[/list]

Whether you're a puzzle mastermind or just want to mess around with new ideas, the Level Editor is your new playground! have fun!
